newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market slow - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested on a live basis, USDA said.
Demand and seller interest was light and trade slow. Offerings were current.
Steers: Select to mostly choice 2-4, no sales.
Heifers: Select to mostly choice 2-4, no sales.
On a carcass basis (weight only) slaughter steers and heifers were not established, compared with Friday's close.
Steers: select to mostly choice 2-4, no sales.
Holstein: (weight only) select to mostly choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs, 2 ld, $98.00-$100.00 per cwt.
Heifers: Select to mostly choice 2-4, no sales.
Wk to date: 400 Week Ago: 2,000 Year Ago: 1,800
